definition: to become dented.
example_en: The side of the pot fell and became dented.

definition: a man of hearty, playful good-humour; a fun-loving, jovial man.
example_en: The jovial man of our village makes everyone laugh.

definition: a fold or folds of a cloth.
example_en: The folds of her sari looked beautiful.

definition: to make feel less sad or disappointed; to comfort (another in difficult condition); to console.
example_en: He consoled his sad friend with words.

definition: that which contains common salt (sodium carbonate).
example_en: You must add a little of the salt-containing substance to the cooking.

definition: the state or condition of being not available; non-availability.
example_en: The non-availability of this fruit is greater during the rainy season.

definition: a variety of sugarcane.
example_en: The juice of the ramagabbu variety of sugarcane is very sweet.

definition: knowledge - a) the fact or process of knowing; b) the fact that is known.
example_en: Do not do any work without knowledge.

definition: as much as is usu. taken into the mouth at one time; a mouthful; a morsel.
example_en: He did not swallow even a single mouthful of rice.

definition: any of a genus (Bison) of wild, bovid ruminants having curved horns, and humped back; a bison.
example_en: The bison was grazing grass at the foot of the hill.

definition: one whose profession is to grind grains into flours.
example_en: The flour-grinder was grinding rice in the mill.

definition: lack of normal intelligence; stupidity.
example_en: Showing stupidity, he became a laughing stock.

definition: corresponding with; comfortable or suitable to; congruous.
example_en: His attire was suitable to the occasion.

definition: the act or process of taking off, subtracting from.
example_en: The expense was subtracted from the total amount.

definition: a knot tied at a relatively lower part (as around the ankle).
example_en: He tied a knot at the lower end of his dhoti.

definition: to burn ablaze.
example_en: The fire blazed up in the forest and spread everywhere.

definition: a plant that lives on or in another plant and obtains nutriment from the later.
example: ಈ ಬಿಂದಣಿಕೆ ಗಿಡವು ಆ ಮರವನ್ನು ಆಶ್ರಯಿಸಿದೆ.
example_en: This parasitic plant has taken shelter on that tree.

definition: a ritual of tonsuring a male child for the first time.
example_en: They performed the child's first tonsuring ritual at the temple.

definition: a mobile chair mounted on large wheels, for persons unable to walk; a wheel-chair.
example_en: They seated the grandmother on a wheel-chair and took her along.

definition: a container of standard capacity, used in measuring liquids; a measuring-vessel.
example_en: The shopkeeper measured the oil with the standard measuring-vessel.

definition: praising the fire god, Agni; praise of Agni.
example_en: The priests chanted the hymns praising the fire god Agni.

definition: a device to push into a bag of grains or other material, and take a small quantity out as a sample.
example: ರೈತನು ಮುಡಿನಾಳಿಯಿಂದ ಚೀಲದ ಅಕ್ಕಿಯ ಮಾದರಿ ತೆಗೆದನು.
example_en: The farmer drew a sample of rice from the sack using a mudinali.

definition: the land features of a particular region.
example_en: The land features of this region are full of hills.

definition: (masc.) a human being, as in feudal systems, owned as property by, and is absolutely subject to the will of, another; bondservant divested of all freedom and personal rights; a slave.
example: ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಲಾಮನಿಗೆ ಯಾವ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯವೂ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: In earlier times, a slave had no freedom at all.

definition: immediately; at once; suddenly.
example_en: He got up suddenly and ran away.

definition: to consider (more than one thing, person, etc.) alike or equal.
example_en: He considers everyone alike.

definition: any of the highly poisonous substances.
example_en: That plant contained a highly poisonous substance.

definition: to make a sound like that of a prolonged s, as of a goose or snake when provoked or alarmed; to hiss.
example_en: The frightened snake hissed and raised its hood.

definition: an embroidered woollen cloth.
example_en: She wore an embroidered woollen sari for the wedding.

definition: the state or quality of being crooked; crookedness.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ದಾರಿಯ ಅಂಕುಡೊಂಕು ಪ್ರಯಾಣವನ್ನು ಕಷ್ಟಕರವಾಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The crookedness of the mountain road made the journey difficult.

definition: (one's promise) to be breached; to fail.
example_en: His word was breached and everyone was disappointed.

definition: lack of something essential or required; imperfection; a defect; a deficiency.
example: ಈ ಯೋಜನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣದ ಕುತ್ತ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: A shortage of funds is clearly evident in this project.

definition: a man of dignity; a dignified man.
example_en: That elder was a dignified man whom everyone respected.

definition: physical exhaustion, as from hard work.
example: ಇಡೀ ದಿನ ದುಡಿದು ಅವನಿಗೆ ವಿಪರೀತ ಅಸುರುಸುರು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: He became extremely exhausted from working the whole day.

definition: (dial.) coarse powder, small pebbles, etc.
example_en: Coarse gravel had fallen on the path.

definition: having embroidery work done with gold, silver or silk threads).
example_en: That embroidered cloth was expensive.

definition: multiplied; increased by so many times.
example_en: That number had been multiplied threefold.

definition: a harmless, moderate-sized, tropical lizard, Iguana tuberculata of Iguanidae family, having a row of spines from neck to tail, which is known for its grip and used in scaling forts, and which feeds on insects or vegetation; the common iguana.
example_en: The iguana was hiding at the base of the plant.

definition: the physical body (as different from the soul).
example: ಜಡದೇಹ ಆತ್ಮದಿಂದ ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The scripture says the physical body is different from the soul.

definition: a sound made by gently patting repeatedly to make a baby sleep.
example: ತಾಯಿ ಮಗುವನ್ನು ಚವ್ವಿ ಎಂದು ಮೆಲ್ಲನೆ ತಟ್ಟಿ ನಿದ್ರೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother gently patted the baby with a soft sound and put it to sleep.

definition: to please; to gratify; to make one like or pleased with.
example_en: Her words pleased everyone.

definition: the act or duty of guarding; careful watch; wariness; defense; protection; a guarding.
example_en: The soldiers were guarding the fort.

definition: a small hill; a mound; a hillock.
example_en: A small hillock was visible in the middle of the field.

definition: (dial.) a kind of ornament for the ear.
example_en: She had worn the akkivole ear ornament.

definition: a pain in the flank.
example_en: A pain in the flank has been troubling him for many days.

definition: to become subdued; to come under others control.
example_en: The disciple stood subdued before the teacher's words.

definition: a man who is condemned or denunciated.
example_en: It is hard to live as a condemned man in society.

definition: a string of gold or silver for wearing round the neck; a necklace.
example_en: Her necklace suited her neck very well.

definition: this man.
example_en: This man had come here yesterday.

definition: a portable shelter of skins, canvas, plastic or the like, supported by one or more poles or a frame and often secured by ropes fastened to pegs in the ground; a tent.
example: ಅವರು ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಡೇರೆ ಹಾಕಿ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕಳೆದರು.
example_en: They pitched a tent in the forest and spent the night.

definition: a loud, long and shrill cry made indicating pleasure or pain.
example_en: She let out a shrill cry of pain and screamed.

definition: a man carrying a burden.
example_en: The burden-carrier brought the goods from the market carrying them.

definition: a sudden but not voluntary reaction or instinctive movement in response to a stimulus; a reflex action.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಸುತ್ತಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಮೊಣಕಾಲು ಬಡಿದು ಪರಾವರ್ತಿತ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor tapped the knee with a hammer and tested the reflex action.

definition: an agricultural implement used for cutting, lifting, turning over, and partly pulverising soil; a plough.
example: ಎತ್ತುಗಳು ನೇಗಿಲ್ ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತಾ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗಿದವು.
example_en: The oxen moved forward in the field, dragging the plough.

definition: the tropical, fragrant orchid Vanilla walkeriae of Orchidaceae family.
example_en: The vanilla vine was full of fragrance.

definition: a Dravidian language prevalent in parts of Madhya Pradesh, in Central India.
example: ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಕೆಲವು ಜನರು ಕುಈ ಭಾಷೆ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Some people in Madhya Pradesh speak the Kui language.

definition: a kind of herb.
example: ಈ ಕೆರೆಯ ದಂಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊರಿಗೊರಿ ಗಿಡ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: The korigori herb has grown on the bank of this pond.

definition: a company of travelers, esp. of merchants or pilgrims traveling together for safety, as through a desert.
example_en: The caravan crossed the desert and moved on.

definition: whole; entire; complete.
example_en: This project has been completed wholly and entirely.

definition: a single finger.
example_en: The bangle was small and got stuck on a single finger.

definition: to take with a trump.
example_en: He skilfully took the trick with a trump in the game.

definition: any of various nonmetallic compounds, synthetically produced, usu. from organic compounds by polymerisation, which can be molded into various forms and hardened or formed into pliable sheets or films, fibers, flexible or hard foams, etc. for commercial use; plastic.
example_en: These toys are made from plastic.

definition: an inhaling of smoke of certain burning objects, in treating certain diseases.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಆ ರೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಧೂಮಪಾನ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ಸೂಚಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor prescribed smoke-inhalation treatment for that disease.

definition: the tree Clerodendrum phlomidis of Verbenaceae family; downy glory tree.
example_en: The downy glory tree had blossomed in the forest.

definition: a heart disease marked by high rate of heart-throbs.
example_en: Suffering from a rapid heart condition, he consulted a doctor.

definition: a game of skill played by two players on a chessboard, each with 16 pieces limited in movement according to kind, the object being to checkmate the opponenṭs king; chess.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಂಜೆ ಮೊಮ್ಮಗನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಶತರಂಜ ಆಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Grandfather used to play chess with his grandson every evening.

definition: a deity that watches over or protects; a tutelary deity; a presiding or patron deity.
example_en: The tutelary deity of that village protects everyone.

definition: in advance; ahead; before.
example: ಅವನು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗಿಂತ ಮುಕ್ಕಟ ಹೋಗಿ ಸ್ಥಳ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He went ahead of everyone and prepared the place.

definition: a platform on which plays are presented; a stage.
example_en: The actors performed the drama on the stage.

definition: a country in south central Asia, between Iran and Pakistan, having Kabul as its capital.
example_en: The capital of the country of Kamboja is Kabul.

definition: the herb Zingiber officinale of Zingiberaceae family; ginger.
example_en: A little ginger is needed for the cooking.

definition: (fire) to catch; to start consuming.
example_en: A spark caught in the dry grass and fire started.

definition: the plant Allium cepa of Liliaceae family; onion plant.
example_en: I brought the onion needed for cooking from the market.

definition: to string (pearls, beads, et.) on or as on a thread; to thread.
example_en: She threaded the pearls onto a string.

definition: to keep the hand on.
example: ಆತ ಮಗುವಿನ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಕೈಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: He affectionately kept his hand on the child's head.

definition: to get sheltered; to be housed in.
example_en: As the rain came, people took shelter in the pavilion.

definition: great joy; delightment.
example: ಮಗುವಿನ ಜನನ ಇಡೀ ಮನೆಗೆ ಸನ್ಮುದ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The child's birth brought great joy to the whole household.

definition: to pay the stipulated tax (to the government).
example_en: The farmers pay tax to the government every year.

definition: the act of praising, extolling or flattering.
example_en: Everyone showed praise for his work.

definition: the father of one's grand father; great grand-father.
example: ನನ್ನ ತೊಂಡಜ್ಜ ಇನ್ನೂರು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಬದುಕಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: My great grand-father lived two hundred years ago.

definition: a ploughing of a fallow land.
example_en: The ploughing of the fallow land had to be finished before sowing.

definition: adequately or sufficiently.
example: ಅವರು ಪ್ರಯಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇಕಾದಷ್ಟು ಆಹಾರವನ್ನು ಪಾರಂ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They gathered enough food adequately for the journey.

definition: light emanating from a red lamp, flare or light passing through red glass.
example: ಕೆಂಪು ದೀಪದ ಕಿಸುಗದಿರ್ ಕೋಣೆಯ ತುಂಬ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The red glow of the lamp spread throughout the room.

definition: to gleam; to glitter or glisten; to sparkle.
example_en: The stars glitter at night.

definition: heaviness (as a quality of things).
example_en: The heaviness of this iron box was such that it could not be lifted.

definition: a married woman, as related to her husband; a wife.
example_en: He set out to the village with his wife.

definition: the lustre of the eye.
example_en: The sparkle of her eyes became inspiration for the poet.

definition: a ladder made or cords.
example_en: They lowered a rope ladder to descend into the well.

definition: a pit in the ground in which to bury a dead body; a burial it; a grave.
example_en: The villagers dug a grave for the corpse.

definition: a hedge on the side (of a field).
example_en: The farmer repaired the side hedge of the field.

definition: a man who elects; a qualified voter.
example_en: Every voter has the right to cast a vote.

definition: a kind of deer.
example_en: The hunter chased the kadithi deer.

definition: the colour of growing grass or foliage; green colour.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಇಳಿಜಾರು ಹಸು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಹುಲ್ಲಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The slope of the hill was covered with green-coloured grass.

definition: ignorance - a) the condition or quality of being ignorant; lack of knowledge, education, etc.; b) unawareness (of).
example_en: His ignorance became the cause of many troubles.

definition: the inner part of the body.
example_en: The doctor examined the inner part of the body.

definition: to mark - a) to put or make a mark or marks on; b) to identify or designate by or as by a mark or marks.
example_en: The teacher marked the important sentences with a line.

definition: a physical fight exchanging blows (with the fists).
example_en: A fistfight broke out between the two boys.

definition: a string or garland of flower.
example_en: The daughter wound a garland of flowers around her hair.

definition: to allow to go to front or move ahead.
example_en: They let the elderly move ahead in the queue.

definition: a man desirous of victory, success.
example_en: That man desirous of victory toiled day and night for success.

definition: a line of connected cars pulled or pushed by a locomotive on a specially laid down rail-track; a train.
example: ಆ ಟ್ರೈನು ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ ತಲುಪಿತು.
example_en: That train reached the station right on time.

definition: a swimming on the surface facing upward and without much movement of hands and legs.
example: ಅವನು ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತೇಲೀಜು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: He rested while floating on his back in the water.

definition: to become thick or fat.
example_en: After eating well, the child grew plump.

definition: the condition of being excessive; excessiveness.
example_en: The excessiveness of the heat was unbearable.

definition: fit to be utilised, enjoyed.
example_en: These fruits are fit to be enjoyed by everyone.

definition: the large herbivorous, artiodactylous mammal Hippopotamus amphibius, of Hippopotamyidae family with a heavy, thick-skinned, almost hairless body and short legs; a hippopotamus.
example_en: The hippopotamus dives and grazes in the river water.

definition: to be or become clean; to be cleansed.
example_en: After the rain, the air becomes clean.

definition: flimsy or thin in texture or substance; lacking firmness; sleazy.
example_en: This cloth is flimsy and tears easily.

definition: a dog.
example_en: The wild dog hunts in a pack.

definition: an intelligent, wise woman.
example_en: She is a very intelligent and wise woman.

definition: a curl or lock of hairs.
example_en: The child's curl of hair looked very beautiful.

definition: (dial.) a man who lacks courage; a coward.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಒಬ್ಬ ಅದುರುಗ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೂ ಬೆದರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That boy is a coward, getting scared even at a small sound.

definition: a decorating or being decorated.
example_en: The decoration of the temple was done for the festival.

definition: to choose or select by vote, as for an office or as a representative; to elect.
example_en: The villagers elected the new chairman.

definition: the sound of a hoarse laugh.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಗಹಗಹ ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ತಿರುಗಿ ನೋಡಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone turned to look when they heard his hoarse laugh in the assembly.

definition: a man who owes something, esp. money taken on loan; a debtor.
example: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಆ ದೇಣೇದಾರನಿಗೆ ಸಾಲ ತೀರಿಸಲು ಸೂಚನೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The bank sent a notice to that debtor to repay the loan.

definition: a brief, often incidental, reference or statement; a mention.
example: ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ನಮೂದು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a brief mention of that matter in the letter.

definition: the plant Clypea hernandifolia.
example_en: The paatha plant is used for medicine.

definition: a false witness, proof, testimony, evidence.
example_en: That man was caught giving false testimony.

definition: a particular lock or hold in wrestling.
example_en: The wrestler defeated his opponent using the seravattani hold.

definition: the rampart of a fort.
example: ಸೈನಿಕರು ಆಳ್ವರೆ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಂತು ಕಾವಲು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The soldiers stood on the rampart of the fort keeping watch.

definition: an order issued by a court of law declaring a person bankrupt.
example_en: The court issued him an order of bankruptcy.

definition: the quality of being trustworthy; trustworthiness; dependability; reliability.
example_en: Everyone knows his trustworthiness.

definition: to scratch the itching part of the body.
example_en: He scratched the spot where the mosquito had bitten.

definition: pitiable; poor; helpless; wretched.
example: ಆ ಕೃಪಣ ಮುದುಕನ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕರುಣೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: Everyone felt pity seeing the state of that wretched old man.

definition: a man who has attained physical and mental maturity; a matured man.
example: ಆ ಯುವಕ ಈಗ ಪ್ರವುಡ ವಯಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That young man has now reached mature age.

definition: Pārvati.
example_en: The devotees worshipped Pārvati in the forest.

definition: any of various families of winged insects that undergo complete metamorphosis, having a slender body with the abdomen attached by a narrow stalk, biting mouthparts, and, in the females and workers, a vicious sting that can be used repeatedly; a wasp.
example_en: The wasp that came out of the nest stung him.

definition: the raising ground bordering a river, sea etc.; bank.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ತಪ್ಪಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೀನುಗಾರರು ಬಲೆ ಬೀಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Fishermen cast nets on the riverbank near that village.

definition: any sticky substance, used as an adhesive.
example_en: He stuck the paper with adhesive glue.

definition: to bring to an end; to finish; to close.
example_en: He quickly brought his work to an end.

definition: sodium borate, a white, anhydrous, crystalline salt, Na2B4O7, with an alkaline taste, used as a flux in soldering metals and in the manufacture of glass, enamel, artificial gems, soaps, antiseptics, etc.; borax.
example_en: They use borax in the manufacture of soap.

definition: a respectable, honourable man.
example_en: Everyone respected that honourable man.

definition: causing great dread, fear or terror; terrible; dreadful.
example_en: That scene was dreadful.

definition: a contemptuous laughter; a disrespectful or deriding smile.
example: ಅವಳು ಅಡ್ಡನಗೆ ಬೀರಿ ಅವನ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಕಡೆಗಣಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She gave a contemptuous smile and ignored what he said.

definition: to become partially ruined and in need of repairs, as through neglect.
example_en: The old house slowly fell into disrepair.

definition: nine times.
example: ಅವನು ಆ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ತೊಮ್ಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಮುಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He finished doing that work nine times.

definition: the state of being morally owing some responsibility to another; the feeling of moral responsibility; obligation.
example_en: Helping my friend is my moral obligation.

definition: a small wooden seat, without a back rest, but with legs; stool.
example_en: The grandmother sat on the wooden stool and rested.

definition: the amorous sport.
example_en: They were engaged in amorous sport in the garden.

definition: the state of being confused; confusion; bewilderment.
example: ಅಚಾನಕ್ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ವೈಕ್ಲವ್ಯ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: On hearing the sudden news, he was thrown into bewilderment.

definition: the quality of being honest and just; truthfulness; uprightness; integrity.
example: ಆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಯ ನೀಯತ್ತು ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That officer's integrity was famous throughout the town.

definition: the thread spread crosswise on the loom.
example_en: The weaver slowly inserted the crosswise thread.

definition: the art of planting, tending and managing forests; forestry.

definition: to cause to go back, retreat.
example_en: The teacher sent the children back to the classroom.

definition: to become bent or twisted out of shape, as wood in drying; to warp.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಣಗಿದ ಮರದ ಹಲಗೆ ಕೋಡುಂತಳೆದು ಬಾಗಿಹೋಯಿತು.
example_en: The wooden plank dried in the sun and warped and bent.

definition: any of numerous arachnids of the order Scorpionida, widely distributed in warmer parts of the world, having a long, narrow, segmented tail that terminates in a venomous sting; a scorpion.
example_en: A scorpion was hiding under the stone.

definition: (pl.) letters; correspondence.
example_en: The letters and correspondence arrived by post.

definition: to be or become detestable or loathsome; to become repugnant.
example_en: If the food is left like that, it becomes repugnant.

definition: mettle; bravery; vigour; fortitude; pluck.
example_en: Everyone admired the soldier's bravery.

definition: name of a region including the present Bengal and northern part of Orissa in Eastern India.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಗೌಡ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಈಗಿನ ಬಂಗಾಳವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The ancient Gauda region included present-day Bengal.

definition: the state or quality of being sublime, majestic, noble, etc.; superiority in rank, position, character, achievement, etc.; greatness; eminence; sublimity.
example_en: Her nobility and greatness were renowned throughout the kingdom.

definition: a container filled with water, hung above an idol, through a small hole in which, water continuously falls on the idol.
example: ಧಾರೆವಟ್ಟಲಿನಿಂದ ವಿಗ್ರಹದ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀರು ಸತತವಾಗಿ ಬೀಳುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Water was falling continuously on the idol from the vessel hung above it.

definition: a sweet and low tone.
example_en: Her sweet, low-toned voice attracted everyone.

definition: a gold necklace.
example_en: She was wearing a gold necklace.

definition: a string of gold or silver for wearing round the neck; a necklace.
example_en: A gold necklace was shining around her neck.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: The shade of that sede tree was cool.

definition: a thin, long leather strap.
example_en: He tied the box with a thin leather strap.

definition: a cluster or tuft of things growing together; a collection of things of the same kind fastened or grouped together or regarded as belonging together; a bunch.
example_en: They prepared a bunch of darbha grass for the worship.

definition: a woman selected (for a post, esp. in an organisation or government) by voting by a large number of persons as their representative; an elected female representative.
example_en: She became the elected representative of the village panchayat.

definition: treated respectfully or courteously.
example_en: Guests should be treated as people who are treated respectfully.

definition: the prickly nightshade Solanum jacquini of Solanaceae family.
example_en: The prickly nightshade plant had grown on the field's border.

definition: to bathe (a person, idol, etc.) in water or other liquid.
example_en: He bathed the child in warm water.

definition: excitement of valour.
example_en: The soldiers rushed into the battlefield with excitement of valour.

definition: a person who travels; a traveller.
example_en: A traveller rested by the roadside.

definition: the quality or state of being tranquil; calmness; serenity; tranquility.
example_en: Through meditation, his mind attained tranquility.

definition: to proceed following the right order.
example_en: Write the questions by arranging them in proper order.

definition: copper sulphate.
example_en: Copper sulphate is used for water purification.

definition: an elderly woman.
example_en: The elderly woman was telling a story to her grandchild.

definition: Śiva, the fiery-eyed god.
example_en: The devotees worshipped the fiery-eyed Shiva with devotion.

definition: either of the lips.
example_en: The poet compared her lip to a flower.

definition: any of several diseases of tropical forest regions, esp. a severe variety of malarial fever; jungle-fever.
example_en: He, who wandered in the forest, caught jungle fever.

definition: engaged in; employed; occupied with.
example_en: He was engaged in social service.

definition: a strong, coarse fibre used for making burlap, gunny, cordage, etc., obtained from plants Corchorus capsularis and C. olitorius, of Tiliaceae family; jute.
example_en: They make bags and ropes from jute.

definition: any bacterial toxin mixed with one's food with the intention of causing sickness; food-poison.
example_en: Food-poison had been mixed into that meal.

definition: the taste that produces a burning sensation in the mouth, throat, etc.
example_en: There is too much pungent taste in this dish.

definition: excessive eagerness.
example_en: His excessive eagerness drew everyone's attention.

definition: a man carrying a burden.
example: ಆ ಹೊಱೆಕಾಱ ಮನೆಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯ ಹೊರೆ ಹೊತ್ತು ಬಂದನು.
example_en: That burden-carrier came home carrying a bundle of firewood.

definition: to be cut into two pieces.
example_en: The fallen pot was cut into two pieces.

definition: to shout; to shout down.
example_en: The leader of the group shouted down at the people.

definition: a brake, in a vehicle, operated by hand.
example_en: The driver pulled the hand brake and stopped the vehicle.

definition: to cause to flow out.
example_en: The engine caused smoke to flow out.

definition: a kind of good white paper.
example_en: They had used Kashi paper for that letter.

definition: (masc.) what or which person; who.
example_en: Who is the man sitting in that room?

definition: a learned man; a specialist in a particular branch of learning; a scholar.
example_en: That scholar was proficient in the scriptures.
